description: MainActivity.java is an Android Java source file that demonstrates use of navigation and action drawers on Android Wear. It manages UI components such as drawers, fragments, and handles user interactions like selecting planets and displaying their details.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that handles the setup of wearables navigation and action drawers, manages the solar system data, and responds to user interactions.

classes.name: PlanetFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays the image of the currently selected planet; used within MainActivity to show planet details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components, and loads the initial planet.

methods.name: initializeSolarSystem
methods.description: Builds and returns an ArrayList of Planet objects representing the solar system.

methods.name: onMenuItemClick
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks from the action drawer, displaying information about the selected planet.

methods.name: updatePlanet
methods.description: Updates the displayed planet image in the PlanetFragment.
